implementation: open-sse/services/usage/tokenrouterQuotaAdapter.js (single canonical implementation; no src/lib compatibility shim needed)
credential: connection.managementApiKey (existing encrypted top-level field, decrypted on read)
activationPrerequisites: Auth owner enables TokenRouter credential create and update using encrypted top-level storage.
Auth owner adds an authenticated read-only management-key probe and activates registry usage flags.
Coordinate usage-handler wiring and quota presentation for unlimited keys, expiry and currency; pass the owner-required gate and independent review before activation.
limitations: No public handler or registry activation; no live provider validation.
Only the first 100 keys are requested; wallet failures are reported as partial results.
Relay routing is refused because it forwards authorization headers; selected proxies must not fall back to direct transport.
Source treats wallet balances as USD and key quotas as reported numeric values; no inference readiness or allowance is inferred.
qualification: Standalone adapter is staged and unadvertised; registration owners receive the final gated/reviewed head separately. No full source-PR parity or live-provider claim.
